(function () {
  'use strict';

  var HOLO_BLOG_TITLE = "Arrington Consultancy";
  var HOLO_T = {"allArticles":"All articles","backToAll":"Back to all articles","empty":"No published articles yet.","blogArticles":"Blog articles"};
  var HOLO_ARTICLES = [{"slug": "the-busiest-person-in-the-building", "title": "The Busiest Person in the Building \u2014 and Why It Costs You", "date": "18 Nov 2026", "isoDate": "2026-11-18T09:30:00.000Z", "excerpt": "Too much still depends on you \u2014 here is where the time goes.", "imageUrl": "https://images.example.invalid/hero.jpg", "content": "<h1>Why it happens</h1><p>Owners are usually the best person for the job when the business starts \u2014 you know the customers, the margins and the people.</p><h2>Where to start this month</h2><ol><li>Write down the three decisions you make most often.</li><li>Pick one of them.</li></ol><p><b>Review it</b> in four weeks. You can take the <a href=\"https://www.arringtonconsultancy.com/owner-dependency-quiz\">Owner Dependency Quiz</a> or <a href=\"https://www.arringtonconsultancy.com/#contact\">book a 30 minute conversation</a>. See also <a href=\"https://example.org/report\">this report</a>.</p><script>alert('x')</script><img src=\"https://images.example.invalid/inline.png\" onerror=\"alert(1)\"><p style=\"color:red\" onclick=\"x()\">A styled paragraph.</p><p><a href=\"javascript:alert(1)\">bad link</a></p><iframe src=\"https://evil.example\"></iframe><p></p>"}, {"slug": "rules-that-backfire", "title": "Rules That Backfire", "date": "11 Nov 2026", "isoDate": "2026-11-11T09:30:00.000Z", "excerpt": "", "imageUrl": null, "content": "<p>Before you add a rule to fix a problem, ask what behaviour it will reward, and who will be affected. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. More words here. </p>"}, {"slug": "Bad Slug!", "title": "Never shown", "isoDate": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "excerpt": "x", "content": "<p>x</p>"}, {"slug": "no-words", "title": "Also never shown", "isoDate": "2026-11-02T00:00:00Z", "excerpt": "x", "content": "<script>x()</script>"}, {"slug": "rules-that-backfire", "title": "A second article with the same address", "isoDate": "2026-11-03T00:00:00Z", "excerpt": "x", "content": "<p>dup</p>"}];

  var container = document.getElementById('holo-blog');
  if (!container) {
    console.error('Holo Blog: No element with id="holo-blog" found');
    return;
  }

  var originalTitle = document.title;
  var descMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
  var hadOriginalDescription = Boolean(descMeta);
  var originalDescription = descMeta ? descMeta.getAttribute('content') || '' : '';

  var getRequestedSlug = function () {
    try {
      return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('post') || null;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  };

  var getArticleUrl = function (slug) {
    try {
      var url = new URL(window.location.href);
      url.searchParams.set('post', slug);
      return url.pathname + url.search;
    } catch (e) {
      return '?post=' + encodeURIComponent(slug);
    }
  };

  var getListUrl = function () {
    try {
      var url = new URL(window.location.href);
      url.searchParams.delete('post');
      return url.pathname + (url.search || '');
    } catch (e) {
      return window.location.pathname;
    }
  };

  var safePushState = function (state, title, url) {
    try {
      history.pushState(state, title, url);
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  var safeReplaceState = function (state, title, url) {
    try {
      history.replaceState(state, title, url);
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  var injectJsonLd = function (data) {
    var jsonLdId = 'holo-blog-jsonld';
    var existing = document.getElementById(jsonLdId);
    if (existing) existing.remove();
    var script = document.createElement('script');
    script.id = jsonLdId;
    script.type = 'application/ld+json';
    script.textContent = JSON.stringify(data);
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  };

  var updatePageMeta = function (article) {
    if (article) {
      document.title = article.title + ' | ' + HOLO_BLOG_TITLE;
      var desc = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
      if (!desc) {
        desc = document.createElement('meta');
        desc.setAttribute('name', 'description');
        document.head.appendChild(desc);
      }
      desc.setAttribute('content', article.excerpt);

      var canonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"][data-holo]');
      if (!canonical) {
        canonical = document.createElement('link');
        canonical.setAttribute('rel', 'canonical');
        canonical.setAttribute('data-holo', 'true');
        document.head.appendChild(canonical);
      }
      canonical.setAttribute('href', window.location.href);

      var articleJsonLd = {
        '@context': 'https://schema.org',
        '@type': 'BlogPosting',
        headline: article.title,
        description: article.excerpt,
        datePublished: article.isoDate,
        url: window.location.href,
      };
      if (article.imageUrl) articleJsonLd.image = article.imageUrl;
      injectJsonLd(articleJsonLd);
      return;
    }

    document.title = originalTitle;
    var listDesc = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
    if (hadOriginalDescription) {
      if (listDesc) listDesc.setAttribute('content', originalDescription);
    } else if (listDesc) {
      listDesc.remove();
    }
    var listCanonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"][data-holo]');
    if (listCanonical) listCanonical.remove();

    injectJsonLd({
      '@context': 'https://schema.org',
      '@type': 'Blog',
      name: HOLO_BLOG_TITLE,
      blogPost: HOLO_ARTICLES.map(function (a) {
        var post = {
          '@type': 'BlogPosting',
          headline: a.title,
          description: a.excerpt,
          datePublished: a.isoDate,
          url: window.location.origin + getArticleUrl(a.slug),
        };
        if (a.imageUrl) post.image = a.imageUrl;
        return post;
      }),
    });
  };

  var styleId = 'holo-blog-styles';
  if (!document.getElementById(styleId)) {
    var style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = styleId;
    style.textContent =
      '.holo-blog{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,sans-serif;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;color:#1a1a1a;background:transparent}' +
      '.holo-blog *{box-sizing:border-box}' +
      '.holo-blog a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}' +
      '.holo-blog-header{display:none;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}' +
      '.holo-blog-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:transparent;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;color:#666;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:6px;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;text-decoration:none}' +
      '.holo-blog-back:hover{background:#f5f5f5;border-color:#d0d0d0}' +
      '.holo-blog-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}' +
      '.holo-blog-card{display:flex;gap:20px;padding:20px;background:transparent;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}' +
      '.holo-blog-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-color:#d0d0d0}' +
      '.holo-blog-card-thumb{width:140px;height:100px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0;background:#f0f0f0}' +
      '.holo-blog-card-content{flex:1;min-width:0}' +
      '.holo-blog-card-title{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600}' +
      '.holo-blog-card-excerpt{margin:0 0 10px;color:#555;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}' +
      '.holo-blog-card-date{font-size:13px;color:#888}' +
      '.holo-blog-article{padding:4px 0 24px}' +
      '.holo-blog-article-hero{display:block;width:100%;max-height:360px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;margin:0 0 20px;background:#f0f0f0}' +
      '.holo-blog-article-title{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:28px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em}' +
      '.holo-blog-article-date{display:block;margin-bottom:20px;font-size:14px;color:#888}' +
      '.holo-blog-article-content{font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:#222}' +
      '.holo-blog-article-content p{margin:0 0 1em}' +
      '.holo-blog-empty{padding:32px 16px;text-align:center;color:#666;border:1px dashed #ddd;border-radius:12px}' +
      '@media (max-width:640px){.holo-blog-card{flex-direction:column}.holo-blog-card-thumb{width:100%;height:160px}.holo-blog-article-title{font-size:24px}}';
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  var escapeHtml = function (str) {
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  };

  var findArticle = function (slug) {
    for (var i = 0; i < HOLO_ARTICLES.length; i++) {
      if (HOLO_ARTICLES[i].slug === slug) return HOLO_ARTICLES[i];
    }
    return null;
  };

  var renderList = function () {
    if (HOLO_ARTICLES.length === 0) {
      return '<div class="holo-blog-empty"><p>' + HOLO_T.empty + '</p></div>';
    }
    var html =
      '<section class="holo-blog-list" role="feed" aria-label="' +
      HOLO_T.blogArticles +
      '">';
    HOLO_ARTICLES.forEach(function (article) {
      html +=
        '<a href="' +
        escapeHtml(getArticleUrl(article.slug)) +
        '" class="holo-blog-card" data-slug="' +
        escapeHtml(article.slug) +
        '" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/BlogPosting">';
      if (article.imageUrl) {
        html +=
          '<img class="holo-blog-card-thumb" src="' +
          escapeHtml(article.imageUrl) +
          '" alt="' +
          escapeHtml(article.title) +
          '" loading="lazy" decoding="async" itemprop="image" />';
      }
      html += '<div class="holo-blog-card-content">';
      html +=
        '<h2 class="holo-blog-card-title" itemprop="headline">' +
        escapeHtml(article.title) +
        '</h2>';
      html +=
        '<p class="holo-blog-card-excerpt" itemprop="description">' +
        escapeHtml(article.excerpt) +
        '</p>';
      html +=
        '<time class="holo-blog-card-date" datetime="' +
        escapeHtml(article.isoDate) +
        '" itemprop="datePublished">' +
        escapeHtml(article.date) +
        '</time>';
      html += '</div></a>';
    });
    html += '</section>';
    return html;
  };

  var renderArticle = function (article) {
    var html =
      '<article class="holo-blog-article" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/BlogPosting">';
    if (article.imageUrl) {
      html +=
        '<img class="holo-blog-article-hero" src="' +
        escapeHtml(article.imageUrl) +
        '" alt="' +
        escapeHtml(article.title) +
        '" loading="lazy" decoding="async" itemprop="image" />';
    }
    html += '<header>';
    html +=
      '<h1 class="holo-blog-article-title" itemprop="headline">' +
      escapeHtml(article.title) +
      '</h1>';
    html +=
      '<time class="holo-blog-article-date" datetime="' +
      escapeHtml(article.isoDate) +
      '" itemprop="datePublished">' +
      escapeHtml(article.date) +
      '</time>';
    html += '</header>';
    html +=
      '<div class="holo-blog-article-content" itemprop="articleBody">' +
      article.content +
      '</div>';
    html += '</article>';
    return html;
  };

  var processContentLinks = function (parentEl) {
    var links = parentEl.querySelectorAll('.holo-blog-article-content a');
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
      links[i].setAttribute('target', '_blank');
      links[i].setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
    }
  };

  var showArticle = function (slug) {
    var article = findArticle(slug);
    if (!article) {
      showList({ shouldReplaceUrl: true });
      return;
    }

    var articleUrl = getArticleUrl(slug);
    if (window.location.pathname + window.location.search !== articleUrl) {
      safePushState({ post: slug }, '', articleUrl);
    }

    updatePageMeta(article);

    var header = container.querySelector('.holo-blog-header');
    var content = container.querySelector('.holo-blog-content');
    header.style.display = 'flex';
    content.innerHTML = renderArticle(article);
    processContentLinks(content);
    container.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  };

  var showList = function (options) {
    var shouldReplaceUrl = Boolean(options && options.shouldReplaceUrl);
    var listUrl = getListUrl();
    if (window.location.pathname + window.location.search !== listUrl) {
      var writeHistory = shouldReplaceUrl ? safeReplaceState : safePushState;
      writeHistory({ post: null }, '', listUrl);
    }

    updatePageMeta(null);

    var header = container.querySelector('.holo-blog-header');
    var content = container.querySelector('.holo-blog-content');
    header.style.display = 'none';
    content.innerHTML = renderList();

    var cards = content.querySelectorAll('.holo-blog-card');
    cards.forEach(function (card) {
      card.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        showArticle(card.getAttribute('data-slug'));
      });
    });
  };

  window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
    var slug = getRequestedSlug();
    if (slug) showArticle(slug);
    else showList();
  });

  var backArrow =
    '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/></svg>';
  container.innerHTML =
    '<div class="holo-blog">' +
    '<div class="holo-blog-header" style="display: none;">' +
    '<a href="' +
    getListUrl() +
    '" class="holo-blog-back" aria-label="' +
    HOLO_T.backToAll +
    '">' +
    backArrow +
    HOLO_T.allArticles +
    '</a>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="holo-blog-content"></div>' +
    '</div>';

  container.querySelector('.holo-blog-back').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    showList();
  });

  var initialSlug = getRequestedSlug();
  if (initialSlug) showArticle(initialSlug);
  else showList();

})();
